name: svartalfar_adept
description: a Svartalfar Adept (Fall from Heaven), a dark-elf mage: pale grey-lavender skin, long straight white hair, long pointed ears and violet eyes, a deep purple hooded robe with silver-white trim and a pale silver rune on the skirt, a dark sash belt, a brown leather satchel on a strap across the chest hanging at the screen-left hip with a rolled scroll sticking out, black boots, and a tall twisted dark wooden staff topped with a glowing blue crystal wrapped in curling silver tendrils, held upright in the LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays upright in the left hand on the screen-right side and the right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist resting on the satchel

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the crystal-topped staff tilted up), the hood and white hair flying
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff tilting, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering until it points out to the right, the robe bunching
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal top of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging, the satchel against the ground
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the hood falling back
death.5: hits the ground: lying on the back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, white hair spread on the ground; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the purple robe spread out
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the robe and the satchel settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on the back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside the body
